## About
Guy was a technician at Florida Generator before he and his wife Ivonne took over the shop. They've been serving Orlando ever since, and Auto Tender is still family owned and operated. We treat you like one of our own, because that's how we want to be treated.
We handle the everyday work, like maintenance, brakes and batteries, and the really complex mechanical and electrical problems too. Reviewers mention Nick, Paul and Guy by name, and they'll explain what's going on with your car in plain terms.
Our customers give us 4.8 stars on Google from 342 reviews. Bring your vehicle to us and let our family take care of yours.

## Services
- Maintenance: Routine upkeep and the small issues that come up along the way, with parts replaced when they need it.
- Brakes, Tires, Suspension: Stopping, rolling and riding smooth.
- Engine & Transmission Repair: From engine trouble to transmission problems, done honestly.
- Batteries & Starters: Car won't start? We'll find out if it's the battery or the starter.
- Struts and Shocks: Worn struts and shocks replaced so the car handles the way it should.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Fill out the online estimate form on our website and we'll get back to you.

Q: Do I need to schedule a drop off?
A: Give us a call and we'll set up a time for you to drop off your car.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 1818 N Dean Rd in Orlando. It's a 6-bay shop with a clean, comfortable customer waiting room.
